title: read the list again when a run stops, heard from a run made after the screen
why: The cards' subscription to the runs a no-op (issue 433, part c): a card stays at laying out after its run ends, and the list is never read again.

title: read the list again when a run stops, heard from a run made after the screen
why: The cards' subscription made once rather than for each list (issue 433, part c): `subscribeToRuns` hears only the runs that existed then, so a run made since is never heard.
